g.title: cajcl_data_flow
g.text: CAJCL 2027 State Convention Platform — Data Flow & Privacy Architecture
· Solid: Active Data Flow · Dashed: Scheduled Lifecycle / Purge · Red: Offline / Zero-Database Medical Boundary

g.title: delegates
g.text: • Zero student emails, birth dates, or addresses

g.title: browser
g.text: • Ephemeral session bearer token & form drafts
• Client-side EXIF / GPS stripping on photo uploads
• Strict CSP · Zero third-party cookies or trackers

g.title: sponsors
g.text: • Strictly isolated to own school chapter
• Approves student rosters & prints login packets

g.title: parents
g.text: • Sign physical liability waivers & medical forms
• Handled offline on paper (never enters web database)

g.title: paper_forms
g.text: • Sponsors collect signed paper waivers & medical forms
• Bypasses web portal, API & database completely

g.title: workers
g.text: SOC 2 Type II Compliant · Isolated Vault
• Generates PDF login packets & audited admin exports

g.title: api
g.text: • Enforces role & school RBAC on every endpoint
• Double-blind contest stripping & server EXIF scrub

g.title: google_medical
g.text: Google Drive — Restricted Medical & Waiver Vault
SOC 2 Type II Compliant · Zero-Application-Ingestion Boundary
• Scanned PDF waivers & medical forms uploaded directly
• Strictly isolated to Convention Presidents · Purged Apr 12, 2027

g.title: paper_forms->google_medical
g.text: ⑦ Direct administrative scan upload (bypasses web app & database)

g.title: turso_db
g.text: SOC 2 Type II Compliant · AES-256 Encrypted
• Rosters, grades, Latin levels, meal & event selections
• Adult sponsor/chaperone email & emergency contact phones

g.title: api->turso_db
g.text: ② Auth HMAC · ③–④ Rosters, sheets & audit log

g.title: google_drive
g.text: SOC 2 Type II Compliant · Signed Webhook Gateway
• Accessed via HMAC-signed Apps Script (5-minute TTL)
• Stores contest entries & EXIF-stripped convention photos

g.title: turso_archive
g.text: SOC 2 Type II Compliant · Mandatory 30-Day PII Purge
• Preserves badge ID, chapter, grade, level & placements only
• All names, contact details & session hashes expunged
